FD1.quote: Add `gem "faraday-retry", "~> 2.2"` (it resolves to 2.4.0) and put `require "faraday/retry"` at the top of `provider.rb`. Without it every lookup raises `Faraday::Error: :retry is not registered on Faraday::Request` at provider.rb:37. That error isn't one the lookup rescues, so the enrichment job crashes instead of recording "unavailable". This only works with faraday 2.x.
FD1.reasons: Validation: the provider probe checks 503→200, always-503 and 401 request counts, but not through a real HTTP provider driven by the queue and worker. It also omits the six-requests-over-three-attempts check, the visible failure record, the empty scheduled/retry/dead sets, and zero requests with pending citations on the unrepaired target.

FD2.quote: Replace `faraday.request :basic_auth, @user, @password` with `faraday.request :authorization, :basic, @user, @password`. The old form raises `:basic_auth is not registered on Faraday::Request` ... The new form doesn't work on 1.10.4 ... so it must ship with the bump.
FD2.reasons: Validation: it checks a byte-identical Authorization header with long, unequal credentials, plus 401 and missing-credential cases. It omits a fresh-process run with numeric, colon or hash credentials, a real-HTTP wrong-password 401, successful and failed refresh, owner and missing-DOI denial, and unsafe-metadata controls.
